thread:
maya_sales: OrionPay asks for a CompetitorX -> Redwood migration POC next week. Key asks: streaming stop-token parity, token-billing reconciliation, and matching burst RPS. Who can lead tech presales and parity checks? cc @zach_se @nina_se

zach_se: I can lead the parity harness. Need sample payloads and their streaming framing (do they use NDJSON or SSE?).

maya_sales: They use chunked streaming with newline-delimited JSON chunks and send `session_id` header. Uploaded samples to Confluence.

ben_solutions: I'll prep a tiny proxy shim to normalize headers and reframe chunks. Example mapping: `x-client-session -> session_id`, stream_mode: ndjson. Will attach Docker compose.

nina_se: I'll handle the security questionnaire. Maya: please share their legal contact and whether they require dedicated/no-retention.

maya_sales: Shared legal; they prefer 0-day retention but ok with Dedicated.

zach_se: For token-billing we should offer a reconciliation run during the POC (run their corpus on both sides and produce a delta report). I'll run initial smoke tests (stop-token edge cases, repeated delimiters) and post results by Fri.

ops_bot: Sandbox `orion-poc-sbx-3` provisioned (2 GPU nodes). IPs DM'd.

maya_sales: Timeline: SQ answers by Thu, parity smoke by Fri, demo next Tue. Owners: Zach (parity), Nina (SQ), Ben (proxy). Confirm?

zach_se: Confirmed.

nina_se: Confirmed.

ben_solutions: Confirmed. Will push compose + curl demo to the thread link.

maya_sales: Thanks all, I'll update the customer and send invites.
